command:
set -euo pipefail; echo IDENTITY_HOST=$(hostname); echo IDENTITY_USER=$(id -un); systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p DropInPaths -p ExecCondition -p ExecStopPost; echo CONFIG_BEGIN; grep -E '^(ENTITYOS_ROOTFS_RUN|ENTITYOS_DATA_DIR|ENTITYOS_IDENTITY_BINDS)=' /etc/entityos/entityos.conf || true; echo CONFIG_END; echo ROOTFS_BEGIN; stat -c 'PATH=%n TYPE=%F MODE=%a UID=%u GID=%g MTIME=%y' /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run 2>/dev/null || echo ROOTFS_MISSING=1; find /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share -maxdepth 4 -type f -name '*.db*' -printf 'ROOTFS_FILE=%p|%s|%T@
' 2>/dev/null | sort || true; echo ROOTFS_END; echo DURABLE_SEMANTIC_BEGIN; find /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state -maxdepth 5 -type f -printf 'DURABLE_FILE=%p|%s|%m|%T@
' 2>/dev/null | sort || true; if [ -f /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json ]; then echo CUTOVER_MANIFEST_SHA=$(sha256sum /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json | awk '{print $1}'); cat /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json; else echo CUTOVER_MANIFEST_MISSING=1; fi; echo DURABLE_SEMANTIC_END; echo RESCUE_BEGIN; find /var/lib/entityos/data/volatile-state-rescue -maxdepth 8 -type f -printf 'RESCUE_FILE=%p|%s|%m|%T@
' 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -100 || true; echo RESCUE_END; echo MOUNTS_BEGIN; findmnt -R /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run 2>/dev/null || true; echo MOUNTS_END; echo PROCESS_ROOT=$(readlink -f /proc/319869/root 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING); echo DONE=1
